assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished landscape website-card illustration for Esteban Moreno Media, a creative video production and editing service. Create a sophisticated tactile 3D editorial illustration with beautifully modeled miniature objects, ceramic and matte painted materials, fine physical details, soft photographic studio light, ambient occlusion and long elegant shadows. Warm ivory background #fbf6ef, near-black equipment, restrained burnt terracotta #9f3c27, pale sage and cool glass highlights. Art-directed, quietly playful, contemporary design studio quality; never generic flat SaaS illustration, clip art, icon pack or primitive blocks. Landscape 3:2 composition, main objects large and occupying about 80% of the frame, all important forms fully visible, subject in the middle with small clean perimeter. No words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI labels, humans or faces. Each object must visually explain the service. Do not produce a website mockup, only the illustration. Scene: an exquisite miniature South Florida modern home with a warm terracotta roof detail, cream walls, glass windows, one sculptural palm and a short entrance path. A professional near-black mirrorless camera stands beside it, with three generous photographic frame shapes showing complementary architectural views arranged as a restrained editorial fan. The home is the hero, the camera and frames clearly tell the story of real estate photo/video content. Believable light and spatial composition, no busy confetti, no floating social icons, no drones.
